_readme: Per-image recipe for turning deck renders into web images for this page.
Source files are the deck exports; they are NOT committed (public repo).
Coordinates for fill/blur are relative to the image after any crop.
Only two views carried client branding; everything else is unmarked.

reception-and-waiting.note: no client mark — reception desk, lounge and stone floor only
reception-and-waiting.alt: Office reception desk and visitor lounge with stone flooring and full-height glazing
reception-and-waiting.caption: Reception and visitor waiting, with the stone floor carried through to the lift lobby. Indicative viewpoint.

reception-and-arrival.note: CLIENT MARK: dimensional logo lettering on the reception back-wall
reception-and-arrival.alt: Reception counter in a corporate office with a plain feature wall and lounge seating
reception-and-arrival.caption: Arrival: a stone-floored reception with the back wall left plain for signage. Indicative viewpoint.

open-plan-workplace.note: CLIENT MARK: logo applied to the blue column facing the floor
open-plan-workplace.alt: Open-plan office workstations either side of a wide central circulation gallery
open-plan-workplace.caption: The central gallery held clear between two workstation bands. Indicative viewpoint.

md-suite.alt: Managing director's office with a meeting table, lounge seating and city views
md-suite.caption: MD suite, combining a work desk, a meeting table and an informal lounge. Indicative viewpoint.

boardroom.alt: Sixteen-seat boardroom with a long table, wall-mounted screen and joinery storage
boardroom.caption: The 16-seat boardroom, sized 5250 x 1850 mm on plan. Indicative viewpoint.

meeting-room-eight-seat.alt: Eight-seat meeting room with a large screen and floor-to-ceiling glazing
meeting-room-eight-seat.caption: One of two enclosed meeting rooms retained from the source layout. Indicative viewpoint.

client-lounge.alt: Private client lounge with banquette seating, a dining table and fluted glass screens
client-lounge.caption: Private client lounge and dining for four, screened from the open floor. Indicative viewpoint.

cafe-and-call-booths.alt: Office cafe with banquette seating beside a row of enclosed single-person call booths
cafe-and-call-booths.caption: Cafe seating with call booths alongside — the pressure valve for an open floor. Indicative viewpoint.

pantry.alt: Office pantry with laminate cabinets, a sink run, coffee machine and easy-clean flooring
pantry.caption: Pantry finished for cleaning rather than appearance alone. Indicative viewpoint.

layout-option-01-plan.alt: Rendered floor plan showing two bands of workstations either side of a central gallery
layout-option-01-plan.caption: Option 01: pantry and dining only, with the most generous circulation.

layout-option-02-plan.alt: Rendered floor plan with a cafeteria in the top left corner and denser workstation banks
layout-option-02-plan.caption: Option 02: a 45-seat cafeteria takes the corner, and desk banks tighten to compensate.

layout-option-03-plan.alt: Rendered floor plan packed with workstation rows and a reduced cafeteria area
layout-option-03-plan.caption: Option 03: maximum desks, with cafeteria seating cut back to 23.

workstation-reference-plan.alt: Annotated office plan numbering every workstation and marking the central gallery
workstation-reference-plan.caption: The interior study: 68 desks in the upper band, 102 in the lower, MEP zone excluded.
